title: Annual Leave Policy
body: Employees accrue paid vacation based on tenure and may request time off with at least two weeks' notice for planned leave.

title: Payroll Timing
body: Payroll is processed on the last business day of each month and deposits are reflected by the next banking day.

title: Benefits Enrollment
body: Employees may update benefit selections during the annual enrollment window or within 30 days of a qualifying life event.
